test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven friends H, J, K, L, M, N, and O are sitting around a circular table facing the centre H is sitting to the immediate right of L. N is sitting exactly between J and K. M sits to the immediate left of O. N sits second to the left of M. Who sits to the immediate right of O?
solution:
Seven friends H, J, K, L, M, N, and O are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) M sits to the immediate left of O and N sits second to the left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5272111d5b3fa3e4b8103fb0eb1097249a993eaab04efd08a3aa0935dd518e6.png] 

2) N is sitting exactly between J and K and H is sitting to the immediate right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9e5a5e42552954ccb68a53a1c8dc1173e2a4b86f737e9d6ac19449df4231a11.png] 

∴ Here, 'L' sits to the immediate right of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"L".**
